stories.title: A truck driver and his mystery passenger died in 1991. Now, 35 years later, there's a breakthrough
stories.summary: The unidentified passenger was known as "Helen Doe" for decades before DNA testing revealed her name.

stories.title: Driver dies after crashing into retention pond in southwest Houston, officials say
stories.summary: Investigators are working to determine what led up to the deadly crash.

stories.title: HCSO: Deputy shoots armed woman during mental health crisis call in NW Harris County
stories.summary: A 49-year-old woman was hospitalized after a Harris County deputy shot her while responding to a mental health crisis call on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Thanksgiving Day fire prompts second-story window escape in northwest Harris County, officials say
stories.summary: Two people escaped through a second-story window during a Thanksgiving Day house fire in northwest Harris County. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: HPD: Driver found passed out behind wheel leads officers on chase
stories.summary: A driver was taken into custody after a brief police chase ended with a crash through a home's fence in north Houston. No serious injuries were reported.

stories.title: Crews working to recover vehicle from bayou in south Harris County
stories.summary: Marine units are responding after a vehicle went off the road and into a bayou near South Sam Houston Parkway West and Buffalo Speedway.

stories.title: 'It sounded like an explosion' | Train derailment rattles Houston neighborhood ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: About 10 railcars derailed Wednesday night, rattling Houston neighbors and prompting a hazmat response. Officials confirmed the railcars were empty.

stories.title: 7-year-old critically injured in three-vehicle crash in northwest Houston, police say
stories.summary: A 7-year-old was flown to a hospital in critical condition following a three-vehicle crash at Hammerly Boulevard and Beltway 8, Houston police said.

stories.title: Union Pacific train derails in Houston’s Fifth Ward
stories.summary: Union Pacific said cleanup is underway and an investigation into the incident is underway.

stories.title: Katy boy, 9, to receive life-saving kidney transplant from stranger after unlikely match
stories.summary: The chance a non-family member would be a match is 1%

stories.title: Pearland HS band raises $350,000 to stay in NYC for rescheduled Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: More than 500 band and color guard students will stay for Saturday’s parade after supporters met the goal to cover unexpected travel costs.

stories.title: Sheriff: Man dies after being found unresponsive in Katy-area store parking lot
stories.summary: An elderly man died after suffering an apparent heart attack in the Katy area. Deputies ruled out a pedestrian crash.
